title: Applied AI Engineering
subtitle: From Model Capability to Dependable Product Behavior
description: A practical field book for turning uncertain model capability into useful, measurable, reliable, and governable product behavior through a continuous evidence loop.
author: Komal Nakrani

chapters.title: Behavior, Not Magic
chapters.summary: Establish product behavior as the unit of accountability and build a responsibility charter around a recursive evidence loop.

chapters.title: Start With the User Task
chapters.summary: Turn a request for AI into a falsifiable task, consequence, baseline, value hypothesis, evidence log, and valid stop path.

chapters.title: Write the Behavior Contract
chapters.summary: Specify required, uncertain, abstaining, escalating, degraded, and prohibited behavior with explicit evidence and authority.

chapters.title: Choose the Simplest Adequate Mechanism
chapters.summary: Compare deterministic, retrieval, predictive, multimodal, generative, agentic, and hybrid mechanisms against the behavior contract and select the least complex adequate path.

chapters.title: Make Task Data Representative
chapters.summary: Build a permitted, versioned task-data substrate whose population, provenance, labels, segments, leakage, missingness, and limitations can support or reduce the behavior claim.

chapters.title: Engineer Context and Retrieval
chapters.summary: Design an authorized context path that separates query transformation, candidate generation, ranking, permission, freshness, assembly, provenance, and empty or conflicting evidence behavior.

chapters.title: Draw the Combined System Boundary
chapters.summary: Separate learned behavior, deterministic policy, application state, trust, failure, ownership, and authority so every consequential claim crosses validation before use.

chapters.title: Build an Inspectable Vertical Slice
chapters.summary: Implement one production-shaped behavior path that succeeds, abstains, fails safely, exposes evidence, and runs locally without provider secrets.

chapters.title: Turn Consequences Into Evaluation Cases
chapters.summary: Build a versioned evaluation set whose cases, segments, provenance, ambiguity, coverage, splits, leakage controls, and limits map to the behavior contract.

chapters.title: Name the Errors That Matter
chapters.summary: Classify errors by consequence, segment, severity, detectability, reversibility, and control, then choose thresholds and release dispositions without hiding critical failures behind an average.

chapters.title: Combine Machine, Human, and Domain Judgment
chapters.summary: Assign each system claim to deterministic checks, references, calibrated graders, trained raters, specialists, or accountable authorities without laundering agreement into truth.

chapters.title: Run Experiments That Change Decisions
chapters.summary: Preregister reproducible comparisons that isolate a change, preserve paired cases, segments, guardrails, confounds, and negative evidence, and end in an explicit disposition.

chapters.title: Design for Probabilistic Failure
chapters.summary: Model failure by layer, consequence, propagation, and state, then contain it with bounded retries, idempotency, circuits, degradation, reconciliation, and explicit recovery evidence.

chapters.title: Budget Latency, Capacity, and Cost
chapters.summary: Turn user time, tail latency, concurrency, capacity, retries, cache semantics, quality, and total cost into a segment-preserving product envelope.

chapters.title: Observe Behavior Without Betraying Users
chapters.summary: Build decision-bearing signals, redacted traces, feedback paths, retention controls, and diagnostic views that reveal product behavior without routine raw-content surveillance.

chapters.title: Implement Controls and Preserve Authority
chapters.summary: Translate threats and harms into implemented, tested, monitored controls with explicit residual limits, qualified review, and named authority.

chapters.title: Release to Learn Safely
chapters.summary: Match exposure to the next justified uncertainty with versioned readiness evidence, restricted cohorts, explicit stop triggers, and rehearsed rollback authority.

chapters.title: Diagnose Real Use and Incidents
chapters.summary: Contain consequence, reconstruct layered evidence, test and disconfirm hypotheses, protect sensitive traces, verify recovery, and change durable artifacts.

chapters.title: Change Models Without Losing the Product
chapters.summary: Inventory, replay, compare, release, and roll back model or provider change against an unchanged product behavior contract.

chapters.title: Earn Reuse From Repeated Evidence
chapters.summary: Separate reusable mechanisms from local evidence and authority, validate stable seams across consumers, and reject abstractions that have not earned their blast radius.

chapters.title: Lead Applied AI Decisions
chapters.summary: Direct attention across unlike systems, communicate at the right altitude, preserve evidence and authority, and grow by improving the decisions and people around the work.
